prompt_html: Which of the following is a Greek variable commonly associated with measuring the sensitivity of option prices?

choices_html: The pre-determined price at which an option contract may be exercised.
Higher for a call than for a put.
The price at which the underlying asset closes on expiration day.
The difference between the price of the underlying at expiration and the value of the call or put option.
